details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1045-1082 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The existing-branch ownership check treats commit email and message trailer as proof that the updater wrote the commits, although contributors can forge both.
  WHY: A forged commit can pass the check and be replaced by the lease-checked force-push; reviewers rated this BLOCKER or MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:942-946, 1264-1267 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Early `pr_fail` paths set `delivery=pr` without a `pr_url`, causing Telegram to report a failed PR delivery when no PR exists.
  WHY: The alert renders “Delivered as a pull request (failed): none,” obscuring that the workflow aborted before creating a PR.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1152-1160 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Telegram reports a successful PR delivery when PR creation fails and no URL is output.
  WHY: The notification renders “Delivered as a pull request” based on `COMMIT_DELIVERY=pr` even when the PR was not created.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:pr_fail function definition and the Telegram notification block under `if [ "${COMMIT_DELIVERY:-}" = "pr" ]` | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `pr_fail` sets `delivery=pr` before any PR exists, causing Telegram to report a failed PR delivery with no URL.
  WHY: Early failures can trigger a misleading alert that implies a PR exists.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:970-972 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A failing `git commit --amend` has no error guard to record a structured failure reason.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, the step exits before `pr_fail` logs an `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY` outcome.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:948 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `git commit --amend` exit code is ignored.
  WHY: The reported failure path can continue to a push with inconsistent branch history; DeepSeek and Qwen instead report that `set -e` exits before structured failure output.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:git commit --amend -q -m "${UPDATER_COMMIT_MSG}" -m "Updater-Release-SHA: ${UPSTREAM_SHA}" | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A failing `git commit --amend` exits without calling `pr_fail` or writing structured output.
  WHY: The failure leaves delivery fields unset and no actionable `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY` log line.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1095-1097 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The partial `head:auto/update-workflows-` search qualifier may match branches that are not updater-generated or not for the current release.
  WHY: The result could cause unrelated PRs to be closed; DeepSeek disputes the reported search issue and states the qualifier matches branch-name prefixes.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:Lines 1107–1108 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `head:auto/update-workflows-` search qualifier does not select updater branches with a 12-character SHA suffix.
  WHY: Older updater PRs would remain open; DeepSeek disputes this and states the qualifier matches branch-name prefixes.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:stale-PR lookup at `--search "head:auto/update-workflows-"` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The stale-PR lookup returns no results because `head:auto/update-workflows-` is reported to be an exact-match qualifier, while generated branches have a SHA suffix.
  WHY: The close loop would not close older updater PRs; DeepSeek disputes this and states the qualifier matches branch-name prefixes.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1051-1057 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A `gh pr list` check followed by `gh pr create` has a TOCTOU race between concurrent workflow runs.
  WHY: Both runs can find no existing PR, after which one creation fails despite a PR having been created by the other run.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add `pull-requests: write` to the job permissions only."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`, `jobs.update-wrappers.permissions`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: No job-level `pull-requests: write` permission is added; `tests/test_update_workflows_pr_delivery.py` explicitly asserts that the permission is absent. The workflow comment explains the reusable-workflow permission constraint and use of `GH_PAT`, but the deviation is not reflected in the PR description.
- requirement: "If the plan cannot be read, use the provisional names and behaviour in this issue and record that assumption in a code comment and the PR body."
  expected_change_site: PR #6989 body/description
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow YAML records the assumption in a code comment; the PR #6989 description omits that the plan could not be read and that the names are provisional. Qwen reports the generated updater PR body mentions the assumption, but PR #6989's own description does not.
- requirement: “The PR body states the release tag, SHA, the verification outcome.”
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`, the `Commit and push updates` PR-body construction
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: When manifest verification is disabled, its step outputs `verified=skipped` without a `tag` output; `UPDATER_VERIFY_RELEASE_MANIFEST` defaults to `false` in `README.md`, and missing or invalid `RELEASE_TAG` is replaced with the literal `unresolved`.
- requirement: "Earlier updater pull requests for older releases, opened by the GH_PAT account from this repository, are closed with a comment pointing at the new one."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`, stale-PR close loop driven by `gh pr list --search "head:auto/update-workflows-"`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer reports the `head:` qualifier is exact-match and the generated branches carry a 12-hex SHA suffix, leaving the close loop with no results; the behavioural test's fake `gh` returns a canned list regardless of the search query.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1074-1080 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The existing-branch ownership check trusts spoofable `.commit.committer.email` and `.commit.message` trailer metadata.
  WHY: A contributor can forge the bot email and `Updater-Release-SHA` trailer, pass the guard, and have the lease-checked force-push replace the branch.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:942-946 (pr_fail), 1264-1267 (notification rendering) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Early `pr_fail` paths set `delivery=pr` and `pr_action=failed` without a `pr_url`, so Telegram reports a failed PR delivery when no PR exists.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish a PR delivery failure from an abort before anything reached GitHub.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:970-972 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failing `git commit --amend` has no error guard before `set -euo pipefail` exits the step.
  WHY: No structured `UPDATER_PR_DELIVERY` log line is recorded, leaving the failure untraceable through the log-prefix grep path.
- Requirement: "Add `pull-requests: write` to the job permissions only." (Issue #6989, Scope section, last bullet)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml`, `jobs.update-wrappers.permissions`
  Evidence of absence: The workflow comment at lines 779-784 records a deliberate deviation; `tests/test_update_workflows_pr_delivery.py` lines 145-148 asserts that `pull-requests` is absent. The rationale is not reflected in the PR description.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Expected change site: PR #6989 body/description
  Evidence of absence: The YAML comment at lines 767-784 and changelog fragment `6989-updater-pr-delivery.md` record the assumption, but the PR description omits it.
